Our Story

A Garden Retreat in the Hills

Nestled among green hills and lush lawns, every corner of Namohills is built for easy, honest comfort — peaceful rooms, open-air dining, a marriage garden for your big day, a swimming pool and a turf made for a great game with friends and family.

Set across acres of manicured gardens, Namohills Resort & Garden brings together comfortable stays, warm Indian hospitality and open green spaces for travellers who want more than a hotel room — they want a retreat.

Everything for a Perfect Stay

Floodlit Turf

A covered artificial-grass turf for football and cricket, open from early morning to late night.

Comfortable Rooms

24/7 Guest Support

Our team is available around the clock for anything you need during your stay.

Dining Hall & Cafe

A spacious dining hall and cozy cafe seating, serving fresh Indian and global cuisine.

Marriage Garden

A large green garden for weddings, receptions, engagements and family celebrations.

Swimming Pool

A clean, refreshing pool for family and friends — perfect after a day of play or a long journey.
